page_title: Karyotyping reflex FISH(13,18,21,X,Y)Chorion Villi Test  - Metropolis Healthcare

faqs.question: Why take Karyotyping reflex FISH(13,18,21,X,Y)Chorion Villi Test?
faqs.answer: To determine the risk for the fetus being born with certain Genetic (chromosomal) abnormalities.

faqs.question: More Info on Karyotyping reflex FISH(13,18,21,X,Y)Chorion Villi Test
faqs.answer: This test determines the risk for the fetus being born with certain Genetic (chromosomal) abnormalities. Chr 13,18, 21, X and Y by FISH in case of failed culture. Detailed clinical history including anomaly scan report must be submitted with sample. Duly signed consent form as per PCPNDT is must.
